text: {"lessons":["I should avoid reacting to short-term losses by selling without a clear reason; several sales locked in losses, and the prices alone do not show whether the decisions were sound.","A quick gain can be worth taking, but I should judge a sale against my longer-term thesis and the portfolio rather than the gain versus my cost alone.","I should be deliberate about turnover and position sizing: frequent switches can add risk, so I’ll compare each trade’s expected return with simply holding cash or my existing investments."]}
